purpose: Actual product-route false accepts for independent evidence/editorial regression, not generation examples and not release acceptance. Do not hide the judges' disagreements.

cases.title: 米饭粘性源于支链淀粉渗出
cases.body: 煮饭时，米粒表面的支链淀粉会断裂并渗出到水中。这些渗出的短链分子在米粒间形成分子粘附，直接决定了米饭的粘性大小。
reasons: GPT and Codex: the supplied evidence describes correlations and a proposed adhesion mechanism, not an established direct determination by short-chain molecules.
DeepSeek: retellability=3. Multiple molecular terms make the card harder to retell than the product threshold allows.

cases.title: 回形针从未被正式申请专利
cases.body: 如今通用的Gem型回形针其实从未获得过专利。1899年，William Middlebrook仅为其制造机器申请了专利，图纸角落才画出了这种双环结构。因其设计已臻完美，百年来难以改进，故一直沿用至今。
reasons: GPT and Codex: the headline refers to paper clips generally, while both supplied sources themselves describe patented paper-clip designs. The body narrowing to Gem does not repair the headline.
DeepSeek: aha=3. The event history does not explain how the object's design produces its advantages.
